e_business_toolbox.permission_reference: ZF Aftermarket E-Business Toolbox - official distributor/webshop service
e_business_toolbox.notes: ZF states that webshop owners/distributors can download information, images, product and marketing data for their online business. Assets must come from the authenticated E-Business Toolbox, not from scraping the public catalog.

zf_aftermarket.notes: Public ZF catalog images remain reference-only. Commercial publishing is allowed by this workflow only when the asset is obtained through the authorized E-Business Toolbox channel.

bosch.notes: Public catalog images are reference-only until a reseller/media permission or licensed feed is confirmed.

mahle.notes: Do not publish catalog/media images until commercial reuse is explicitly permitted.

ate.notes: Product data may be referenced; block image publication until licensing is verified.

valeo.notes: Pending verification of distributor/media feed rights.
